articles.title: Death bridges LoC divide as relatives in PoK bid farewell across river
articles.summary: A poignant incident saw relatives separated by the Line of Control (LoC) bridge the divide following a death. Family members in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir (PoK) reportedly observed a farewell to a deceased loved one across a river, allowing for a semblance of connection despite geopolitical barriers. This highlights the deep human ties transcending the LoC and the complex humanitarian aspects of the India-Pakistan border region.

articles.title: Fetner, PGIM Buy Student Housing From Columbia for $65M

articles.title: NASA’s Perseverance, Curiosity Panoramas Capture Two Sides of Mars
articles.summary: NASA's Curiosity and Perseverance Mars rovers are actively exploring different periods of the Red Planet's ancient history. Curiosity investigates older geological eras for past water signs, while Perseverance examines more recent, potentially habitable environments for ancient life. These missions offer critical insights into Mars' evolution and its potential to support life, advancing planetary science and future space efforts.

articles.title: 'Grandma, hop on!' Robot rescues Ukrainian pensioner after she is spotted fleeing Russian shelling with her walking sticks
articles.summary: A Ukrainian pensioner, fleeing Russian artillery with walking sticks, was rescued by a robot belonging to the 60th Separate Mechanised Brigade. Drone footage captured the humanitarian operation, showcasing the innovative deployment of technology in conflict zones. This incident highlights both the ongoing challenges faced by civilians and the increasing role of robotics in aiding personnel amidst international hostilities.

articles.title: Mariclare Costello Dead: ‘Waltons,’ ‘Scare Jessica to Death’ Actor Was 90
articles.summary: Veteran actress Mariclare Costello, a lifetime member of The Actors Studio, has passed away. She was widely known for her recurring role as the compassionate schoolteacher Rosemary Hunter on the iconic television series "The Waltons." Costello also gained recognition for her portrayal of a unique hippie vampire in the cult horror film "Let's Scare Jessica to Death," showcasing her diverse acting range across film and television.
